Name: Lewd Leah
Author: prowlingDemon
Description:
First off, this mod uses assets made by other creators:

The nude portraits are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35/?]AirplaneRandy[/url]
The nude overworld sprites are created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4425]simezi21[/url]

This mod requires SMAPI but nothing else. All you do is put the lewdLeah folder into the mods folder in stardew valley's directory.

Lewd Leah is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1542]Abigail Lewd Dialogue[/url]. I liked the idea, so I applied it to Leah while doing a few things differently. 

I might make changes to this in the future, so please do provide feedback. I might even release similar mods for other characters, be they male, female, or not even human :). It doesn't even have to be sexual.
